mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ()
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.create_date, p.createDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.confirm_date, p.confirmDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS confirmDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.happen_date, p.happenDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS happenDate, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.xy_h, ''), p.xy) AS xyH, p.xy_l AS xyL FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE p.id IN ()

SELECT f.id AS visitId, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id IN () AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY f.patient_basic_info_id, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), f.id

SELECT q.patient_id AS patientId, q.issue_key AS issueKey, q.doctor_id AS doctorId, u.name AS doctorName, q.note, DATE_FORMAT(q.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS time FROM qc_issue_resolution q LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = q.doctor_id WHERE q.patient_id IN ()
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO qc_issue_resolution (patient_id, issue_key, doctor_id, note) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{issueKey}, #{doctorId}, #{note})
